column1: # SuperView Graphics (SGX/SVG), IFF-RGFX, YAFA, CDXL and Amiga bitmap fonts: RECOIL has none of them.

column4: RECOIL has no Amiga SGX support (it only knows the SymbOS SGX) and rejects the file. Layout per Kleinert's SGX spec v4.2 with the sample-measured offsets (data at 822, 8-bit chunky, 256-entry palette). Output matches testimg-lz77.sgx pixel for pixel, and that file's zlib payload inflates to exactly this file's data. Reviewed: clean photo of orange flowers.
